title: 45 CFR 164.404 - Notification to individuals (HIPAA Breach Notification Rule)
publisher: Cornell Legal Information Institute, reproducing the Code of Federal Regulations
claims: Paragraph (b), Implementation specification: Timeliness of notification, provides that a covered entity shall provide the notification required by paragraph (a) without unreasonable delay and in no case later than 60 calendar days after discovery of a breach.
The 60 calendar day period runs from discovery of the breach, and is an outer limit rather than a safe harbor, because notification must also be without unreasonable delay.
